executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 43 errors due to missing critical dependencies. Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang3 packages are not available in the classpath. The pom.xml is missing required dependency declarations for spring-boot-starter-security, spring-boot-starter-data-jpa, and commons-lang3.

errors.message: package org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders does not exist (and 3 related Spring Security imports)
errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is missing from pom.xml. The SecurityConfig class requires spring-boot-starter-security but it is not declared as a dependency.

errors.message: package org.springframework.data.jpa.repository does not exist (affects ColumnRepository, TaskRepository, UserRepository)
errors.root_cause: Spring Data JPA dependency is missing from pom.xml. Repository interfaces extend JpaRepository which requires spring-boot-starter-data-jpa.

errors.message: package jakarta.persistence does not exist (affects all JPA entity annotations)
errors.root_cause: Jakarta Persistence API is missing. This is typically included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa but may need explicit declaration if using custom JPA configuration.
errors.fix_recommendation: Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa is added to pom.xml as it includes jakarta.persistence-api transitively. If issue persists, add explicit dependency: <dependency><groupId>jakarta.persistence</groupId><artifactId>jakarta.persistence-api</artifactId></dependency>

errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 dependency is missing from pom.xml. ValidationUtils class uses StringUtils or other commons-lang3 utilities.

summary: 4 grouped dependency errors found affecting 43 compilation failures
